kernel: gko::kernels::cuda::generic_kernel_col_reduction_2d_blocked<double, rw_fn, rw_op, rw_fin> (direct launch from the driver: grid (1,1), default_block_size = 512 threads, rows = 8, cols = 64)

sites.source: partial = op(partial, block_partial[i + warp_rank]);   (unrolled over i = 0, 32, ..., 480: 16 loads per thread of warp 0)

thread_pair_example: block (0,0), cols = 64, gridDim.y = 1 so col_step = 32 and the column-block loop runs twice: in iteration 1 thread 0 (warp 0) executes LDS block_partial[32] (i = 32, warp_rank = 0) at L317; in iteration 2 thread 32 (warp 1) executes STS block_partial[32] at L309. The only barrier between the iteration-1 read and the iteration-2 write is the one at L310 which sits BEFORE the reads. Warp 0 reading its own slots (i = 0, warp_rank = lane) is same-thread and does not conflict; warps 1..15 are the conflicting writers.
class_reason: Both accesses are plain shared-memory accesses (PTX st.shared.f64 / ld.shared.f64, SASS STS.64 / LDS.64 without .STRONG, no volatile/atomic). A store of warp 1..15 in iteration n+1 and a load of warp 0 in iteration n hit the same shared address with no barrier in between (L310 orders only write-before-read of the same iteration) -> data race of plain accesses (DR). No strong access, so no SC component.
buggy_expected: The pair is reported as DR (WAR, shared, cross-warp): read at L317 (iteration n, warp 0) vs write at L309 (iteration n+1, warps 1..15). It only occurs when the loop runs at least twice, which the driver forces with cols = 64 > col_step = 32; the library reaches that only for cols > 65535*32.

fixed.reason: The fix introduces col_step = gridDim.y * warp_size and adds 'if (block_col + col_step < cols) block.sync();' at L324-L326, after the warp-0 reads and before the next iteration's store at L309. The condition is uniform per block, so the barrier is reached by all threads whenever another iteration follows. SASS: a second BAR.SYNC 0x0 at 0x0b80 after the STG at L320. Line numbers of L309/L317 are unchanged in the fixed file (the one inserted line and one removed line cancel).

Fixed: same code, STS.64 at 0x08a0, BAR.SYNC at 0x08d0, LDS.64 0x0910..0x0ac0, STG at 0x0b50 and a second BAR.SYNC 0x0 at 0x0b80 (L325, conditional). No .STRONG token on any of these accesses. review.notes: Checked against common/cuda_hip/base/kernel_launch_reduction.hpp at e0d4d6e: store block_partial[threadIdx.x] at :309, block.sync() at :310 (the only barrier in the loop body), warp-0 loads block_partial[i + warp_rank], i = 0..480 step 32, at :317 (inside 'if (threadIdx.x < warp_size)' :312), loop header :298-:300. default_block_size = 512 (common/cuda_hip/base/kernel_launch.hpp:48), so block_partial has 512 entries (:291) and the 512-thread direct launch is the right one. The record's 256 would leave entries 256..511 uninitialised. Thread 32w+l (w = 1..15) skips :312, loops back and stores block_partial[32w+l] in iteration n+1 while lane l of warp 0 may still load it in iteration n. Nothing orders the two (:310 orders store-before-load of one iteration only). Both plain shared accesses, so DR; relation cross-warp-same-block. The library reaches a second iteration only when ceildiv(cols, 32) > 65535 (:496-:499 cap gridDim.y), so the direct launch is needed. Fix 4d8ec44: col_step at :297, loop header folded into :299-:300, 'if (block_col + col_step < cols) block.sync();' at :324-:326 (barrier :325). The condition is uniform per block, and :309/:317 keep their line numbers. The fix removes the race: fixed = absent.
